selection_policy: One proposal only; approved19 remains untouched.
Use fixed M001 positive score gain per recorded worker minute; never rank negative ratios as efficient.
Inspect raw accuracy, full score/work frontier and distinct within-series mechanisms alongside efficiency.
Retain the five mandatory anchors with unknown comparable compute left null.
Exclude extreme compute and redundant variants; explicit individual runtime removals remain omitted.
Cheap structural controls may be proposed despite previous old-panel score filters; this is an explicit proposal exception, not a silent active-list change.
Use old52 for screening only; new French scores and ratios must be measured within the new campaign.
